frequency_question: What proportion of major central government vehicle subsidy schemes are fully drafted, cleared by finance, and gazetted within a 323-day timeline from initial concept/mandate?
membership_rule: Includes all centrally sponsored or centrally initiated automotive/EV subsidy, manufacturing incentive, or financing schemes with financial outlay above $100M; excludes state-level schemes and minor administrative amendments.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major national EV/automotive schemes; exhaustive for the specific class of national EV subsidy frameworks post-2010.
known_gaps: Minor variations in bureaucratic bottlenecks for sub-cabinet level initiatives.
skeleton: Total administrative duration = Inter-ministerial consultation (60-90 days) + Expenditure Finance Committee / Cabinet approval (60-90 days) + Scheme guidelines drafting and final gazette notification (30-60 days). Total physical time range: 150 to 240 days.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 identified major comparable schemes within the last decade executing successfully under the 323-day threshold.
validity_reason: General Rules of Business and standard administrative procedures for central ministries in India remain stable over multi-year periods.
